title: Orion Protocol (TradeOnOrion) — Atomic Swap Signature Replay + Balance Accounting Error Analysis
loss_raw: ~$645,000 (BUSDT, ORN, XRP, BNB, and various other tokens)
root_cause: `redeemAtomic()` business logic flaw — double-draining stake balance via signed orders during stake release request, then over-withdrawing
steps: [Step 5] alice → VulnContract: redeemAtomic(order_2) ← same balance reused
3. alice deposits funds + stakes in VulnContract
4. alice → attacker signed orders via redeemAtomic x4
